_meta.note: 單位素材表。每一列 = 一個單位，每一欄 = 損傷程度（完好 / 受損 / 重創）。同一列必須是同一個單位只是損傷不同 —— 這是把三個狀態塞進同一次生成的唯一理由，分次生成必然漂移。切圖器見 tools/slice-sheets.mjs。
_meta.grid: prompt 裡宣告的列數與欄數，必須和 tools/slice-sheets.mjs 的 SHEETS 設定一致

items.name: 我方小隊素材表
items.prompt: A square 1:1 game asset sheet containing exactly 9 top-down military science-fiction infantry tokens, laid out in a clean 3 by 3 grid: 3 rows and 3 columns, with equal generous flat magenta gaps between every subject. No subject may touch, overlap or cast anything onto another. All 9 subjects are drawn at exactly the same scale, each one centred in its own invisible cell, each with a compact footprint that would fit inside a circle. Every figure is seen from STRAIGHT OVERHEAD: you see the top of the helmet, the tops of the shoulders and the weapon foreshortened flat against the body. Within each row the armour design, the colour scheme, the equipment and the silhouette are IDENTICAL - it is the exact same soldier three times - and ONLY the battle damage changes across the columns. Column 1 (left) = pristine, undamaged, fully intact armour. Column 2 (middle) = moderately damaged: armour plates dented and scorched black, one shoulder plate cracked open, a thin wisp of smoke. Column 3 (right) = critically damaged: armour shattered open, internal structural frame exposed, torn cabling hanging loose, sparks and glowing orange hot fractures. ROW 1 is a VANGUARD assault trooper: bulky heavy frontline exosuit, very thick angular shoulder pauldrons, a short stubby close-quarters weapon held across the chest, a narrow cyan-blue glowing visor slit on the helmet and thin cyan-blue trim strips along the shoulders. ROW 2 is a SNIPER marksman: slim lightweight low-profile recon suit, a long-barrelled precision rifle extending forward past the head, a ragged hooded camouflage cloak draped over the back, a single cyan-blue glowing optic lens. ROW 3 is an ENGINEER support trooper: medium-weight suit with a bulky rectangular backpack module and a short antenna, a compact carbine in one hand and a segmented mechanical tool arm on the other side, small cyan-blue indicator lights on the backpack

items.name: 地形與掩體素材表
items.prompt: A wide landscape 3:2 game asset sheet containing exactly 6 top-down military science-fiction battlefield props, laid out in a clean grid of 2 rows and 3 columns, with equal generous flat magenta gaps between every object. No object may touch, overlap or cast anything onto another. All 6 objects are seen from STRAIGHT OVERHEAD and drawn at the same scale, each centred in its own invisible cell, each with a roughly square footprint. ROW 1 is the SAME barricade three times, identical design and colour, only the damage changes: cell 1 is a pristine heavy armoured barricade block, a rectangular gunmetal cover barrier with visible bolt heads, panel seams and a chipped yellow-black hazard stripe along one edge; cell 2 is the same barricade moderately damaged with dents, scorch marks, a cracked corner and chipped paint; cell 3 is the same barricade blown apart into a low pile of twisted buckled plates and rubble with glowing orange embers. ROW 2 contains three different objects: cell 1 is a circular metal landing pad marker set into the ground, concentric rings with worn chevron arrows pointing inward and dim cyan-blue guide lights; cell 2 is a scatter of battlefield debris, broken armour fragments, spent shell casings and torn cabling; cell 3 is a sealed military supply crate with reinforced corners, latches and a small green status light

items.name: 關卡節點圖示
items.style_override: Style: military science-fiction user interface iconography. Each icon is a bold engraved emblem sitting on a circular brushed-gunmetal badge with a strong emissive edge glow. Flat straight-on view, no perspective, no isometric tilt. Thick heavy strokes and large simple shapes only — every icon must stay instantly readable when scaled down to 40 pixels, so no thin hairlines, no fine detail, no small marks. High contrast against the badge face, crisp hard edges, no soft drop shadow. Background MUST be one flat uniform pure magenta #FF00FF field with absolutely nothing else on it, no gradient, no vignette, no shadow or glow bleeding onto the magenta. Every icon fully separated from every other icon by clear empty magenta space. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermark, no signature, no frame.
items.prompt: A wide landscape 3:2 asset sheet containing exactly 8 science-fiction map node icons, laid out in a clean grid of 2 rows and 4 columns with equal generous flat magenta gaps between every icon. No icon may touch or overlap another. All 8 icons are drawn at exactly the same scale, each centred in its own invisible cell, each one a circular badge of the same diameter. ROW 1 left to right: (1) LANDING ZONE - a bold downward-pointing chevron centred inside a circular landing pad with four short guide ticks, cyan-blue emissive; (2) FIREFIGHT - two heavy crossed rifles forming an X, steel grey with warm amber emissive edge; (3) ELITE THREAT - an angular armoured skull sigil inside a bold warning hexagon, deep red emissive; (4) UNKNOWN SIGNAL - three thick expanding concentric arcs radiating from a solid dot, like a radio transmission burst, violet-blue emissive. ROW 2 left to right: (5) SUPPLY - a thick blocky cross on a rounded supply crate, green emissive; (6) BLACK MARKET - a bold stack of three thick credit chips seen edge-on, amber-gold emissive; (7) BOSS - a heavy angular crowned sigil with four sharp spikes, crimson emissive; (8) CORE SHARD - a single bold faceted crystal shard standing upright, cyan-white emissive

items.name: 右側面板背景板
items.style_override: Style: military science-fiction user interface surface art. Flat straight-on view, no perspective. Very dark desaturated palette built on #0C151C and #17262F, with restrained cyan-blue #5DB6FF emissive accents confined to the outer edges and corners only. Deliberately subtle and low contrast — this is a background plate that white text will be laid on top of, it must never compete with the text for attention. Fine even surface detail, no large bright areas, no strong vignette, no film grain, no noise. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no readouts, no screens, no watermark, no signature, no logo.
items.prompt: A tall portrait 2:3 science-fiction control panel background plate that fills the entire frame edge to edge. A dark brushed gunmetal surface with faint etched circuit traces, a very subtle large hexagonal mesh, thin horizontal seam lines and small recessed rivets along the outer margins. Heavy angular bracket corner reinforcements at all four corners, each with a faint thin cyan-blue emissive edge line. A narrow vertical cyan-blue accent strip running down the extreme left margin. The central eighty percent of the plate is intentionally very dark, flat, even and low contrast with almost no detail, because interface text will be placed directly on top of it
